Messages.Author: Xian
Messages.Body:
Again, just clearing up possible problems before they arise in my
local group. I'll add a spoiler at the end of the message, but just
quote the relevant text up here.

Is Armor of Terra playable by a Gargoyle that is *not* a slave with
vic/VIC? Looking at the text, it could be only usable by slaves,
which is okay, but curious from a backstory perspective. Not that
this is all bad. There has to be some benefit to being a Gargoyle
slave, I suppose.

Relevant text:

tha: "Put this card on a slave Gargoyle you control."
vis: "As (tha) above, but put this card on this acting Gargoyle."

One could make an argument that "this acting Gargoyle" replaces the
whole clause "a slave Gargoyle you control" or it could be that the
slave-ness is not modified, simply the actor/recipient of the card.

Little help?

Xian

Armor of Terra.

damage each combat.

Which brings up a question of timing, if Ian does swap to Gargoyle, and then
later Switches back, does the Armor "fall off" since he's no longer a
Gargoyle. I.E. similar to the equipment cards that are clan specific. If
so, then assumably the card would reactive if he were to switch back to
Gargoyle?

Lee

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

> Which brings up a question of timing, if Ian does swap to Gargoyle, and then
> later Switches back, does the Armor "fall off" since he's no longer a
> Gargoyle. I.E. similar to the equipment cards that are clan specific. If
> so, then assumably the card would reactive if he were to switch back to
> Gargoyle?

It stays (it doesn't go to the ash heap), but it only benefits "this Gargoyle",
so a non-Gargoyle Ian would get no benefit.
